created_for: Git commit and SHA1 byte seal strictly before first eligible future draw 2026-11-17; never revise this document after publication.

anytime_valid_monitor.arithmetic: Exact positive integers: E=13^Bonly*7^Aonly/10^(Bonly+Aonly). No floating-point threshold comparison.
anytime_valid_monitor.early_result: E>=20 triggers MANUAL_EVIDENCE_REVIEW_ONLY, never automatic GO or inference about lottery mechanism.
anytime_valid_monitor.familywise_caveat: Threshold 20 applies to this single predeclared process, not to the family of already studied lottery strategies or prior concurrent shadow studies.

prospective_protocol.early_stopping: No early termination of data collection; partial outputs must remain PENDING or REVIEW_ONLY. Never make betting recommendations.
prospective_protocol.future_research_changes: Separate Git manifest and distinct study identifier required; never edit original seal or append a hypothesis post-outcome.
prospective_protocol.interpretation: In a fair IID Lotto649 each fixed legal six-number ticket has chance 1/C(49,6); a higher historical repair score is not itself a predictive likelihood.
prospective_protocol.later_date_schedule: The next 199 official 6/49 draws in strictly ascending chronological order; validate ROC draw IDs and dates including year rollover; no retrospective event selection.
prospective_protocol.observation_source: Append-only canonical CSV/BIN history AND two independently captured immutable publisher-page snapshots per admitted target draw; refuse missing or inconsistent sources.
prospective_protocol.paired_contrast: B_ONLY minus A_ONLY across the same fixed 200 future draws. Under IID, P(B_ONLY)=P(A_ONLY) because individual official prize coverage is identical.
prospective_protocol.primary_endpoint: Per official draw, whether >=1 of four pairwise-disjoint six-number tickets wins any of the eight official prize tiers using main six and special.
prospective_protocol.primary_hypothesis: B has a higher award-bearing draw rate than history-blind A.
prospective_protocol.terminal_rule: After exactly 200 source-verified prospective draws, report B-only/A-only, observed paired rate difference, exact one-sided discordance test and terminal E; never change 200 or tune alternative p after viewing outcomes.

history_blind_control.label: A
history_blind_control.rule: Random(20261113).shuffle(list(range(1,50))); take sorted blocks [0:6], [6:12], [12:18], [18:24]. RNG seed fixed before first target; no history input.

history_optimized_strategy.label: B
history_optimized_strategy.rule: Freeze exact v2.1 four-ticket witness, independently certified global maximum under original frozen 2497-draw M0 Sum/Log/Joint/Shape rank objective. No subsequent reoptimization.

source_baseline.draw_115000105_policy: Bridge draw before prospective start; never evaluated; not used to retune or choose either portfolio.
